trends.details: The day after Halloween, fashion returns to everyday layered fall staples: trench coats in camel, olive and black over oversized knit sweaters and turtlenecks, wide-leg trousers and straight-leg jeans, loafers, ballet flats and ankle boots in beige, brown and black. Suede jackets, mini skirts with sheer tights and knee-high boots, and an Abercrombie fall lookbook keep the same warm-neutral palette going into November.
trends.title: Layered fall outfits, back to everyday staples after Halloween

trends.details: Cozy fall living rooms stay candlelit and layered: light-colored sectional sofas with brown and cream pillows and chunky knit throws, lit fireplaces, chandeliers, candles on mantels and coffee tables, and dried hydrangeas and eucalyptus in vases. Small white pumpkins linger as the last fall accents, and evening tours show the same rooms glowing with warm lamp and candlelight.
trends.title: Cozy fall living rooms, candlelit and layered

trends.details: Soft fall glam holds as the everyday beauty look: warm-toned eyeshadow, softly defined eyes with winged liner and mascara, cream blush and contour for a warm, sculpted cheek, and glossy nude-pink lips over a dewy, light base. Tutorials frame it as the go-to routine for fall — polished but wearable, with highlighter and setting spray to keep the glow.
trends.title: Soft fall glam, warm and glowy
